title: CoreAge Rx Debuts Time Out Nighttime Topical Cream to Target Dehydration and Aging Skin
text:
Prescription formulation combines Estriol, Vitamin C, and Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid to restore firmness and hydration.
Digital health provider CoreAge Rx today announced the launch of Time Out, a specialized prescription topical cream developed to support mature, dry, and dull skin. Engineered specifically for overnight use, the new formulation provides a targeted solution designed to improve firmness, boost radiance, and restore essential moisture balance in aging complexions.
The Time Out formulation relies on a synergistic blend of three key active ingredients:
0.3% Estriol: Helps promote skin elasticity and structural firmness. 5% Vitamin C: Works to brighten dull areas and refine uneven skin tone. 0.5% Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid: Delivers deep, lightweight moisture to soften skin texture. Formulated for simple integration into evening self-care routines, patients apply a thin layer of Time Out to clean, dry skin prior to bed. Because the treatment utilizes potent prescription-strength compounds, a healthcare provider determines the ideal application schedule based on individual skin tolerance. Regular daytime broad-spectrum sunscreen application is strongly advised throughout the regimen.
Access to Time Out is coordinated through the CoreAge Rx digital platform via a streamlined telehealth process. Prospective patients complete a private online medical intake, which undergoes evaluation by a US board-certified physician. Upon clinical approval, the custom prescription is compounded in an American pharmacy and shipped directly to the patient's residence. CoreAge Rx offers the program starting at $48 per month, which includes the physician evaluation and free home delivery with no hidden fees or mandatory contracts.
The addition of Time Out underscores CoreAge Rx's broader focus on preventive longevity and tailored dermatological care. Patients benefit from ongoing access to clinical support and community resources throughout their treatment journey.
To learn how this triple-action formula supports cellular repair and skin vitality overnight, read the in-depth article on CoreAge Rx Introduces Time Out, a Prescription Topical Cream for Mature Skin .
For full product details and medical intake instructions, visit https://www.coreagerx.com/product/time-out/
About CoreAge Rx
CoreAge Rx is an online health platform that connects patients with US-based medical professionals and manages the direct delivery of targeted prescription treatments. By offering convenient virtual consultations and affordable care pathways across metabolic wellness, longevity, and specialized dermatology, CoreAge Rx delivers modern healthcare solutions directly to the patient's door.
For more information about Time Out, visit coreagerx.com
